QuestInfo.name: Crystal Construction
QuestInfo.0: Ask Intaglio to craft a Lambent Crystal.
QuestInfo.1: Check with Intaglio to see if your crystal's done.

0.0: Wherever did you hear that name? Wait, more importantly...you want me to CRAFT it?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. I have need of one.#l\n#k
0.1: You have need of it. How darling. What would you even use it for?\r\n#L0##bI will use it to protect my loved one.#l\n#k
0.2: Oh... Oh! What a SWEETHEART! For you, darling, I will do this. You have the materials?

yes.0: Hold onto the seat of your pants! This is really going to be something!

no.0: You DON'T? Well, you'd better go get them, you silly goose!

1.0: Here we go! Tres magnifique, no?\r\n#L0##bYou have my thanks.#l\n#k
1.1: Now go protect your loved one, you big softy!
